verdict.rationale: LanceDB has a dedicated first-party reranking docs section that says to "use a reranker to improve search relevance." Its example shows reranking applied to hybrid search after creating an FTS index, so reranking is a native query feature. The evidence is thin, though: no specific built-in or integrated reranker models are named. Missing for 10: named built-in/first-party reranker models (e.g., cross-encoder or hosted reranker integrations), reranking on pure vector or FTS queries, custom reranker docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
